answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before transacting, released after a record of honest behavior. One fake identity is cheap, but an attacker wanting many must fund each one, so cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once. Bind each deposit to a unique hardware attestation, like an opal whose flaws are unique and uncopyable. Add a spiral of peer checks: each newcomer needs two established agents to vouch for it, and sponsors lose part of their stake if it cheats. Record every deposit on a public marble ledger, so a cluster of fresh identities is easy to spot and freeze.
